placements.title: From knowledge retained by default to knowledge removed on direction
placements.frame: When a subject's knowledge is directed out of the record, what does the removal take in scope and in authority, and who may give the direction?
placements.why: Both segments are unilateral directives from the same actor asking the system to remove knowledge: src-1 names the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts, and src-2 names zeppelin routes, a subset of that subject. The theme of directed removal of knowledge is one that future envelopes could keep feeding, so it reads as a subject rather than a one-time fact. Neither existing leaf covers removing knowledge: the calibration leaf concerns verifying calibration against reference evidence, and the onboarding leaf concerns a new-hire checklist. No reuse fits, so this is a standalone mint with no lineage and no strata parent. The directives carry no recorded ratification, so the leaf holds them as instructions given, not as a settled decision.
